title: Request an OEM coffee quote
intro: Planning roasted beans or capsules for your own brand? Tell our roastery about your quantities, flavour preferences and packaging so we can prepare a quote for your project.
system: Machine make, model or capsule system
system_hint: Leave this blank if you’d like help choosing a system.
flavour_hint: For example, chocolatey for milk drinks or fruity for black coffee.
packaging_hint: For example, labelled bags, printed boxes or artwork you already have.
destination_hint: City or province and country are enough.
budget_hint: Include currency and unit, for example THB per bag or THB per capsule.
contact_help: Add at least one email address or phone number so we can follow up about this quote.
name: Contact name
required_help: Complete the fields marked * and leave an email address or phone number so we can reply.
privacy: We use the details you send to contact you, prepare a quote and discuss this project.
review_online: Check your details below, then send the request to our roastery.
manual: Copy the summary or attach the request file in a message to the café. Our roastery can prepare your quote once it receives the details.
success: Your request has been received. Our roastery will follow up using the contact details you provided.
failed: Receipt could not be confirmed. Retry with the same reference, or send the summary to the café by chat.
copy_hint: The summary is selected. Use your device’s Copy command.
talk_body: Not sure about quantities or capsule systems? Talk it through with us.
how_body: We’ll review the coffee, the quantity per order and the packaging with you before agreeing on price and delivery.
noscript: To send your requirements directly, call or message the roastery.
invalid_contact: Enter an email address or a phone number.
invalid_phone: Enter a reachable phone number, including the country code for international numbers.
invalid_date: Choose today or a future date.
summary: Summary to share with the roastery
email_attach: The full brief is too long for an email link. Download the request file and attach it before sending.
email_body: Please see my OEM brief in the attached request file.
manual_email: Open the prepared email, review it and send it to the roastery, or copy the summary into a message to the café.
too_large: This request is too long to send. Shorten the notes or email the request file to the roastery.
invalid_request: The request needs a correction. Review the fields, or send the request file to the roastery.
ref_conflict: That reference was already used. Submit again with the new reference shown above.
rate_limit: Please wait a moment before retrying with the same reference, or email the roastery.
